gold.historyOfPresentIllness: The patient is a 20-year-old female presenting with bilateral earwax impaction, decreased hearing, and a sensation of being unbalanced when standing or walking. She reports associated tinnitus in the left ear and notes a history of recurrent ear infections leading to scar tissue that complicates natural cerumen clearance.
